reservation.bodyAr: نستقبل طلباتكم لتجهيز المكونات وخبزها خصيصاً لكم، مع مرونة كاملة في تنسيق موعد الاستلام أو التوصيل المناسب لكم في أي وقت.
reservation.subtextEn: Handcrafted to order by Ayaa Elshikh in Mansoura, Egypt. Pickup and delivery times can be scheduled flexibly at your convenience.

categories.name: Cookies
categories.description: Thick, golden-edged artisanal cookies and cookie tarts baked with rich chocolate chunks, caramel centers, and caramelized biscuit spreads.
categories.slideDescription: Thick, golden-edged cookies and tarts baked to order in small batches—from classic chocolate chunk boxes to molten filled assortments.

categories.name: Brownies
categories.description: Fudgy, crackle-top dark chocolate brownies crafted with pure butter and Belgian cocoa—available in bite boxes, slabs, or custom inscribed trays.
categories.slideDescription: Dense, glossy dark chocolate brownies with a delicate crackled crust—served in bite boxes, classic squares, or personalized celebration slabs.

categories.name: Cinnamon Rolls
categories.description: Pillow-soft, warm brioche spirals layered with fragrant Ceylon cinnamon and finished with six indulgent gourmet glazes.
categories.slideDescription: Pillow-soft brioche spirals swirled with warm cinnamon sugar and crowned with Chocolate, Caramel, Lotus, Kinder, Pistachio, or Berries.

categories.name: Tiramisu
categories.description: Velvety whipped mascarpone layered over espresso-kissed savoiardi biscuits and dusted generously with dark Dutch-process cocoa.
categories.slideDescription: Silky whipped mascarpone cream layered over espresso-soaked ladyfingers and finished with a delicate veil of pure dark cocoa.

products.name: Classic Box
products.description: Six signature thick-baked cookies with crisp golden edges and soft, chocolate-studded centers.

products.name: Flat Cookies Box
products.description: An assorted tasting box of six distinct gourmet cookie flavors, crisp on the rim and chewy throughout.

products.name: Cookie Tart
products.description: A rich, buttery baked cookie shell cradling a luscious chocolate ganache and caramelized finish.

products.name: Brownie Bites Box
products.description: Bite-sized squares of intensely fudgy dark chocolate brownie, crafted for effortless sharing.

products.name: Plain Brownie Box
products.description: A full 20 × 20 cm tray of pure, deeply chocolatey classic brownie with a signature crackle top.

products.name: Custom Writing Brownie Box
products.description: A 20 × 20 cm celebration brownie tray hand-lettered with your personalized message for special occasions.

products.name: Chocolate
products.description: Warm cinnamon brioche roll drizzled generously with silky dark and milk chocolate glaze.

products.name: Caramel
products.description: Soft spiced roll finished with slow-simmered golden butterscotch caramel.

products.name: Lotus
products.description: Fluffy cinnamon spiral topped with melted Biscoff spread and caramelized biscuit crumble.

products.name: Kinder
products.description: Tender cinnamon roll crowned with creamy hazelnut-milk chocolate sauce.

products.name: Pistachio
products.description: Artisanal cinnamon roll finished with rich roasted pistachio cream and crushed pistachios.

products.name: Berries
products.description: Warm vanilla-iced cinnamon roll balanced with a bright, velvety berry compote glaze.

products.name: Tiramisu
products.description: Classic layered dessert crafted with delicate espresso-soaked savoiardi, whipped mascarpone, and fine cocoa.
